title: Logs
finding: What the server and your devices are saying, as it happens.

live.label: Live log
live.cap: Shows the last {{cap}} events; older ones are dropped from this view.

device.title: Device logs
device.intro: The device’s own devRun.log, uploaded here instead of to PetKit. Off until you turn on Collect debug logs on a device, and the device decides when to send one.
device.listFailed: Could not list the device logs: {{error}}

reason.no_bucket_endpoint: this app has no bucket address, so there is nowhere to send the device
reason.authority_not_splittable: the bucket address cannot be split into a host the device can build — it needs a dotted name or IP

device.collecting: Collection is on. The device uploads on its own schedule; a reboot is the usual trigger.
device.notCollecting: No device has debug log collection turned on.
device.badWindow: The server sent something that is not a log window.
